comment: Hand-transcribed expected /ubus decisions for uhttpd option no_ubusauth 1. Not generated from the Python evaluator. Not luci-ssl-25.12 (that profile has no_ubusauth=0).
notes: uhttpd ubus.c uh_ubus_handle_request_object skips uh_ubus_allowed when conf.ubus_noauth is set. That skip is not an ACL grant.
An empty string SID rewrites to the default. A null or omitted SID element is skipped by typed array parsing; subsequent strings shift and the usual call fails parse.
Parse still requires object, function, and a BLOBMSG_TYPE_TABLE data parameter.
Unauthenticated luci-ssl ACLs still grant only luci.getFeatures. This profile does not invent that grant for setPassword; the allow is the HTTP-gate skip.
cgi-io and dispatcher admin/ubus are not this slice. Do not emit policy_grant, authorization_violation, or path_found.

cases.note: An empty string SID is a string slot and rewrites to the all-zero default; the authorization gate is skipped. This is not an ACL grant.
rule_refs: libubox@ff13b89 blobmsg.c blobmsg_parse_array skips type mismatches without advancing the policy index
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_handle_request_object: if (!conf.ubus_noauth && !uh_ubus_allowed) ERROR_ACCESS; skip when ubus_noauth
do not invent a luci-ssl grant

cases.note: Present all-zero SID still skips uh_ubus_allowed. luci-ssl-25.12 unauthenticated setPassword is deny. Not an invented luci-ssl grant.
rule_refs: uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_handle_request_object: if (!conf.ubus_noauth && !uh_ubus_allowed(data.sid, data.object, data.function)) ERROR_ACCESS
luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures; that ACL is not consulted when ubus_noauth
do not invent an unauthenticated luci.setPassword grant

cases.note: Unknown SID would fail uh_ubus_allowed; with ubus_noauth the HTTP gate still allows. Skip is not 'become unauthenticated'.
rule_refs: uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed is not called when conf.ubus_noauth
rpcd@d99f703 session.access on an unknown SID would not match; that check is skipped
do not invent a luci-ssl grant

cases.note: no_ubusauth does not skip parse. Missing BLOBMSG_TYPE_TABLE data is still ERROR_PARSE.
rule_refs: uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_handle_request_object: if (!data.sid || !data.object || !data.function || !data.data) ERROR_PARSE before the ubus_noauth skip
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: fourth parameter must be BLOBMSG_TYPE_TABLE

cases.note: A null first element is skipped, so luci and getFeatures shift into SID and object slots; no function is parsed.
rule_refs: libubox@ff13b89 blobmsg.c blobmsg_parse_array skips mismatched types without advancing
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c rejects missing parsed function

cases.note: Object lookup fails before the authorization gate is skipped.
rule_refs: uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c ubus_lookup_id returns ERROR_OBJECT before uh_ubus_allowed
